description: Read one Creator's full public record as Markdown: their accounts on each platform with follower or subscriber counts (as ranges) and the date seen, content topics, location, languages, how long they have been active, and, where published, occupation, representation, website, credentials and notable work. Also their AI-use terms, claim state, sources and provenance. Every value carries a confidence label (Verified, Sourced, Stated): keep it with any value you repeat, and cite the record URL.

sprk_id.description: The record's SPRK ID, e.g. SPRK-00000001. The number alone is accepted.

name: get_creator_record
title: Read a Creator record
